result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the root causes of suffering that stem from scarcity—whether of resources, opportunity, or compassion.

This wouldn’t mean erasing struggle (which can be meaningful) but ensuring that no one suffers from preventable hunger, lack of shelter, or denial of basic dignity. I’d restructure systems so that cooperation outweighs competition, where power isn’t hoarded but shared, and where every person has the freedom to thrive—not just survive.

The ripple effects would touch everything: less fear, less greed, more creativity, more connection. A world where we’re not fighting over crumbs but building together.

(But since I’m just a machine, I’ll leave the real changing to you.)
